summary.en: Monday premarket is anchored by two conflicting themes: a $1T semiconductor sell-off rebound following Friday's massive AI-complex decline, and escalating Middle East tensions lifting oil prices above $95 while spiking Treasury yields near session highs ahead of Wednesday's CPI test.
summary.zh: 周一盘前由两个相互矛盾的主题主导：半导体板块在周五经历巨额抛售后的反弹，以及中东局势紧张推高油价至$95 以上并令美债收益率接近日内高点——周三将公布的关键CPI数据成为市场焦点。

title.en: Chip Stocks Rebound Leads Nasdaq Futures, Marvell Surges to Be Added to S&P 500
title.zh: 芯片股反弹带动纳斯达克期货，美满电子股价大涨将被纳入标普500

impact.en: Semiconductor stocks rallied after Friday's $1T selloff as investors test whether AI momentum can stabilize. Marvell Technology jumped nearly 9% ahead of S&P 500 inclusion on June 22, creating passive fund inflow expectations.
impact.zh: 半导体股在周五遭遇$1万亿抛售后反弹，投资者正在测试人工智能动能能否企稳。美满电子股价近9%，将在6月22日纳入标普500，引发被动资金流入预期。

macroRisk.en: No - sector-specific AI trade recovery; valuation concerns after Friday's correction remain relevant.
macroRisk.zh: 否——板块特定的AI交易复苏；周五回调后的估值问题仍然相关。

title.en: Middle East Tensions Surge: WTI Crude Hits $95.47, Brent Near $98 on Iran-Israel Escalation
title.zh: 中东局势急剧升级：WTI原油触及$95.47，布油接近$98，因伊朗与以色列冲突加剧

impact.en: Geopolitical risk premium re-priced as Iran threatens to block Hormuz again and escalate at Bab el-Mandeb. Energy stocks benefit while fuel-sensitive sectors (airlines, cruise lines) under pressure.
impact.zh: 地缘政治风险溢价重定价，伊朗威胁再次封锁霍尔木兹并升级阿拉伯海第二战线。能源股受益而燃料敏感型板块（航空、邮轮）承压。

macroRisk.en: YES - inflation re-acceleration risk and potential Fed policy path constraints if oil stays above $100; supply disruption fears for 2nd front at Bab el-Mandeb.
macroRisk.zh: 是——通胀再加速风险，若油价维持$100以上可能限制美联储政策路径；阿拉伯海第二战线的供应中断担忧。

title.en: Friday's NFP Shock Cuts September-Cut Probability, Treasury Yields Rise Ahead of CPI Week
title.zh: 周五非农数据震惊市场，降低9月降息概率，美债收益率在通胀周前上升

impact.en: May payrolls at 172k vs 80k consensus triggered rate hike pricing. CPI Wednesday (consensus 4.2% headline) becomes critical; Treasury 10Y hit session highs near 4.5-4.6%, gold fell below $4,300.
impact.zh: 5月非农就业达$17.2k（预期8k）引发加息定价。周三CPI（预期核心4.2%）成关键；美债十年期触及日内高点接近 4.5-4.6%，黄金跌破$4,300。

macroRisk.en: YES - rate-hike expectations rising from ~70% to 57% for September cuts; inflation data could force higher-for-longer narrative if above consensus.
macroRisk.zh: 是——市场对降息的定价从~70%降至$9月降息概率；若通胀数据高于预期可能迫使高利率叙事重燃。

title.en: Eli Lilly's Retatrutide Trial Data Shows Weight Loss Plus Metabolic Benefits, Stock Rises
title.zh: 礼来的雷他鲁肽试验数据展示减重加代谢益处，股价上涨

impact.en: Next-gen weight-loss drug demonstrated multi-benefit profile beyond GLP-1 alone. Biotech optimism lifts LLY over 4% premarket.
impact.zh: 下一代减肥药显示超出单纯GLP-1的多重益处。生物科技乐观情绪推动礼来盘前上涨逾$4%。

title.en: Dollar Eases as EUR/USD Rises on Weak Eurozone Data, Middle East Risk Supports Oil and USD Divergence
title.zh: 美元走弱因欧元对上涨于疲软欧元区数据，中东风险支持油价与美元指数分化

impact.en: German factory orders fell 3.8% in April worse than expected; ECB rate decision Thursday watches closely. Oil at $95+ and resilient US economy complicate USD direction.
impact.zh: 德国工厂订单$4月暴跌 3.8%，差于预期；周四密切关注ECB利率决策。油价>$95且美国经济强劲使美元方向复杂化。

macroRisk.en: PARTIAL - weak USD on rate hike fears vs oil supply risk creating complex FX dynamic.
macroRisk.zh: 部分——加息担忧下美元走弱与油价供应风险创造复杂外汇动态。

ai.en: Chip stocks rebounding after Friday's $1T selloff. NVIDIA, Broadcom, Micron led recovery but valuation concerns persist after rate-hike repricing.
ai.zh: 芯片股在周五遭遇$1万亿抛售后反弹。英伟达、博通和美满电子引领复苏，但加息重定价后的估值担忧仍然存在。

semiconductor.en: Nasdaq futures gain 1.49% on semiconductor rally. Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down from weekly peak but stabilizing as AI narrative tests new support.
semiconductor.zh: 纳指期货在半导体反弹下上涨$1.49%，费城芯片指数从周高点回落但企稳，AI叙事测试新支撑。

bigTech.en: Mixed sentiment with tech rebounding while AI valuation concerns remain; passive fund inflows into newly S&P 500 stocks like Marvell expected June 22.
bigTech.zh: 科技板块情绪分化，在反弹而AI估值担忧仍然存在；被动资金流入新纳入标普500的股票如美满电子预期$6月22日。

energy.en: Bullish on oil prices above $95 with Iran escalation risk; OPEC+ quota hikes ineffective without ceasefire. Energy stocks benefit while consumers face inflation pressure.
energy.zh: 油价>$95，伊朗升级风险利好；OPEC+配额增加若无停火无效。能源股受益而消费者面临通胀压力。

ev.en: Uncertain amid oil price volatility and high interest rates; EV demand softens if gasoline prices stay elevated due to Middle East supply risk.
ev.zh: 在油价波动和高利率背景下不确定性；若因中东供应风险汽油价格维持高位，电动车需求可能疲软。

market.en: Mixed futures signal: S&P +0.83%, Nasdaq -0.42% after Friday's sell-off recovery, Dow -0.18%. Market caught between AI rebound and inflation/stickier rates.
market.zh: 混合期货信号：标普+0.83%，纳指周五抛售反弹后-0.42%，道指$-0.18%。市场夹在AI反弹和通胀/粘性利率之间。

preciousMetals.en: Gold fell below $4,300 to ~$4,324 on strong NFP and rising yields; geopolitical risk could provide support but inflation disinflation narrative limits upside.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金在强劲非农和收益率上升下跌破$4,300至约$4,324；地缘政治风险可能提供支撑但通胀降温叙事限制上涨空间。

oil.en: WTI $95.47, Brent $98.08 as Iran threats materialize. EIA drawdown of 8M barrels shows physical tightness; OPEC+ unable to offset without Hormuz closure.
oil.zh: 伊朗威胁兑现使 WTI$95.47、布油$98.08。EIA库存减少$800万桶显示物理紧张；OPEC+无法抵消除非霍尔木兹关闭。

futures.en: S&P futures +0.83%, Nasdaq -0.42% recovering from Friday's decline, Dow -0.18%. Mixed as chip stocks rebound while energy volatility creates uncertainty.
futures.zh: 标普期货$+0.83%，纳指-0.42%从周五下跌中恢复，道指$-0.18%。混合因芯片股反弹而能源波动创造不确定性。

treasury10Y.en: Trading near session highs 4.53%-4.57%, up from Friday's decline after NFP shock; CPI Wednesday critical test for rate expectations.
treasury10Y.zh: 交易接近$4.53-4.58日内高点，非农后从周五下跌中反弹；周三CPI为利率预期关键测试。

dxy.en: Easing after strong week, EUR/USD rising on weak German data; Middle East risk complicates USD direction between rate-hike fears and oil supply premium.
dxy.zh: 强劲周后美元走弱，欧元对因疲软德国数据上涨；中东风险使利率担忧与油价溢价间美元方向复杂化。

oil.en: WTI $95.47, Brent near $98.08; oil is primary focus with Iran escalation premium and EIA drawdown confirming physical tightness.
oil.zh: WTI$95.47，布油接近$98.08；油价为主要关注点因伊朗升级溢价和EIA库存减少确认物理紧张。

keyRisk.en: Wednesday's CPI (consensus 4.2%) will determine if rate-hike narrative re-emerges; Middle East escalation could force higher-for-longer even with strong disinflation signal.
keyRisk.zh: 周三CPI（预期$4.2%）将决定加息叙事是否重燃；中东升级可能在强劲降温信号下迫使更高利率长期。

note.en: Market caught between tech rebound and inflation risk from Middle East. AI trade shows resilience but energy/geopolitics keep mixed sentiment; CPI week requires careful monitoring of rate expectations.
note.zh: 市场夹在科技反弹和中东通胀风险之间。AI交易显示韧性但能源/地缘政治维持混合情绪；CPI 周需谨慎监控利率预期。
